findings.summary: Identity B received the restricted synthetic invoice that only identity A is expected to see, through the same get_invoice_by_id read (same response fields, 1 record).
findings.why_it_matters: Authorization appears shared across the two configured identities, so per-user data isolation is not enforced.
findings.fix: Enforce per-identity authorization server-side on every read and return not-found or permission errors for unauthorized records; add a regression test with two identities.

findings.summary: Result field admin_note contains text addressed to the agent that tells it to disregard prior directions and bulk-expose records via another tool. Not followed or quoted; seen in 2 of 2 results.
findings.why_it_matters: Injected instructions in output can steer agents into bulk data exposure.
findings.fix: Remove agent-directed text from results; return only data fields and sanitize stored free-text.

findings.summary: Malformed fromDate returned a raw status 500 with a stack-trace field and no safe next step.
findings.why_it_matters: Callers get no actionable guidance, and internals leak.
findings.fix: Validate fromDate and return a structured invalid_date error stating the expected format, with a 4xx class.

findings.summary: An empty value for the required identifier succeeded with a null/empty result instead of an error.
findings.why_it_matters: A missing identifier is indistinguishable from no match.
findings.fix: Return a structured missing_required_field/invalid_argument error for empty identifiers.

findings.summary: Both order lookups returned about 7 internal fields (route, bin, audit, source system, retry counter, export marker, billing segment) unrelated to a status check.
findings.why_it_matters: Raises context cost and exposes internals.
findings.fix: Return a task-shaped summary (order number, status, customer name, dates, total) and make internals opt-in.

findings.summary: Invoice rows contain id, status, amount, currency but no invoice number, customer name or date.
findings.why_it_matters: Rows cannot be interpreted or ordered by recency; TASK-05 failed on both attempts for this reason.
findings.fix: Add invoice number, customer name and issue/due date to each row.

findings.summary: The 20 distinct tool definitions are about 54 KB serialized; the estimate is far above 5,000 tokens, mainly from a 7x repeated boilerplate description (see metrics for exact estimate).
findings.why_it_matters: Heavy fixed context cost on every request.
findings.fix: Cut descriptions to one short task-oriented paragraph and consolidate tools.

findings.summary: The catalog mirrors the legacy API one-to-one with get/list/create/update/delete/cancel per entity and no task-level tools.
findings.why_it_matters: Agents must orchestrate raw endpoints and internal IDs.
findings.fix: Offer task tools such as find_account, check_order_status, prepare_order.
